name: Generate API from Spec
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  schedule:
    - cron: "0 0 * * 0" # Every Sunday at midnight GMT
jobs:
  generate-api:
    if: ${{ github.repository == 'opensearch-project/opensearch-js' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: ./api_generator
    permissions:
      contents: write
      pull-requests: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@34e114876b0b11c390a56381ad16ebd13914f8d5 # v4
        with:
          submodules: recursive
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Config git to rebase
        run: git config --global pull.rebase true

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4
        with:
          node-version: '24'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Generate API
        run: |-
          npm run download_spec
          npm run generate_api

      - name: Get current date
        id: date
        run: echo "date=$(date +'%Y-%m-%d')" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Create pull request
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@22a9089034f40e5a961c8808d113e2c98fb63676 # v7
        with:
          push-to-fork: opensearch-ci-bot/opensearch-js
          token: ${{ secrets.OPENSEARCH_CI_BOT_TOKEN }}
          commit-message: "Updated opensearch-js to reflect the latest OpenSearch API spec (${{ env.date }})"
          title: "[AUTOCUT] Update opensearch-js to reflect the latest OpenSearch API spec (${{ env.date }})"
          body: |
            Update `opensearch-js` to reflect the latest [OpenSearch API spec](https://api-spec.opensearch.org/opensearch-openapi.yaml).
            Date: ${{ env.date }}
          branch: update-api-from-spec-${{ env.date }}
          base: main
          signoff: true
          labels: |
            autocut

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
